content:
The City of Laredo celebrated the ribbon cutting of the Laredo Fire Department Health & Wellness Center on Friday, a new facility dedicated to the well-being of the city's firefighters and first responders.

The center represents a commitment to the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of first responders, made possible through an investment by the Mayor and City Council.

Mayor Dr. Victor D. Treviño and District 5 Council Member Ruben Gutierrez attended the ribbon cutting.

Sources: City of Laredo.
